findings.body: The database proof exercises scalar queries and several single-dimension groupings, but it never groups by `plant` or `month`, does not enumerate every `FINANCIAL_CATALOG.combinations` entry, and never asserts that Budget is refused for Actual-only dimensions such as `cost_center`. Consequently regressions in supported combinations or reintroduction of Cost Center Budget allocation could leave this required user-facing proof green.
findings.title: Not done: all catalog combinations and prohibited Budget allocations have end-to-end query coverage

findings.body: The real-RBAC proof gives the successful role every required domain, measure, and dimension grant, while its denied role differs only by lacking the `report` action; the only other negative case revokes Plant scope. It never removes `mis-statement`, any of the four required measure grants, or `leaf_key` individually. Dropping enforcement of any of those required grants would therefore leave the end-to-end authorization test green.
findings.title: Not done: each required RBAC grant is independently denied through RbacService

findings.body: Actual values still receive identifiers derived only from a random result UUID; no matching transactions, full count/total, immutable source and mapping pins, permitted scope, or pagination state are prepared or retained. Thus clickable Actuals and available Actual subtotals cannot yet open the required transaction sets. Per the stage assignment, the later DRILL/PAGES task must implement these handles and paging semantics.
findings.title: Later: DRILL/PAGES must replace synthetic drilldown IDs with prepared handles

findings.body: The committed `QUERY.json` contains transient branch and review bookkeeping, is outside the permitted path set, and is not needed by the query implementation or its tests. It should be removed from the product change.
findings.title: Simpler: remove branch-local task state → keep only the permitted implementation paths
